purpose: Developer schema semantics, not owner facts, not customer-question aliases

accessibility.description_en: Access provisions and assistance for people with disabilities or wheelchair users.

age_rating.description_en: Published game age classification, distinct from the venue admission policy.

amount_minor.description_en: Price or fee in minor currency units; zero means confirmed free use.

audience_id.description_en: Visitor group or organization to which this price or package applies.

audience_ids.description_en: Visitor groups eligible for the event.

bindings.description_en: Which buttons or inputs trigger each action, how to press them and the gameplay context.

body.description_en: Information or message announced in this news item.

bookable_periods.description_en: Periods when a play slot can be reserved or played.

booking_product_key.description_en: Verified product identifier used by the reservation API.

building.description_en: Building or tower where the center is located.

capacity_min.description_en: Fewest participants required for this service.

channel.description_en: Communication channel type, such as phone, email, website or on-site desk.

conditions_all.description_en: Conditions that must all be satisfied.

consequence.description_en: Confirmed penalty or consequence of breaking the policy.

coverage.description_en: Whether the full rulebook documentation is complete.

decision.description_en: Whether the behavior is permitted, forbidden, required or conditional.

office_hours.description_en: Hours during which staff respond through this contact channel.

open_periods.description_en: Periods when visitors may enter the venue.

preset.description_en: Name of the control layout or profile.

scope_note.description_en: Situations to which this answer applies and its limitations.

intent_terms: หยุดบริการ

topic.description_en: Semantic subject of this policy, procedure or FAQ.
